breakthroughs.title: Xbox Series X PS\x00\x09 PSO Cache Cracked + Native AMD RDNA2 (GFX10.3) → HLSL / SPIR-V Lifter
breakthroughs.summary: Reverse-engineered the entire 274.16 MB uncompressed PS\x00\x09 PSO cache (driver 930.048.020) to the single byte: 25,471 Graphics PSOs (0x70B), 2,693 Compute PSOs (0x18B), 54,576 metadata blobs, and 21,522 raw unencrypted AMD GFX10.3 (RDNA2) shaders — then built a pure-Rust GFX10.3 disassembler + HLSL SM 6.6 / SPIR-V 1.5 lifter inside PercyStar v1.3.0.
details: Exact PS\x00\x09 layout: Header (0x80) -> Gfx PSOs (25,471*0x70) -> Compute PSOs (2,693*0x18) -> Meta Index (54,576*8) -> Shader Index (21,522*8) -> 31.12 MB Meta Blob -> 240.89 MB raw GFX10.3 code.

Confirmed 100% standard AMD GFX10.3 (Mesa RADV/ACO gfx1030) ISA with zero custom opcodes: 12B NSA image_sample_l, Wave32 VOP2/VOP3, s_clause, s_endpgm (0xBF810000), s_code_end (0xBF9F0000), NGG/Meshlet exp prim, and hardware raytracing image_bvh64_intersect_ray.
Decoded 0x41 USER_DATA root-signature binding records (SRV 0x300, CBV 0x302, UAV 0x303, Sampler 0x002), 0x42 register slots, 0x43 128-bit shader hashes, and COMPUTE_PGM_RSRC1/2 + [numthreads(x,y,z)].
Exact stage breakdown across all 21,522 shaders: 9,580 Compute (CS), 7,463 Pixel (PS), 3,574 NGG/Meshlet (exp prim), 703 Vertex (VS), and 202 Hardware Raytracing (image_bvh64_intersect_ray).
PercyStar v1.3.0 adds a dedicated Shaders (RDNA2) tab + --disasm-shaders CLI exporting .asm, lifted HLSL SM 6.6, and valid binary SPIR-V 1.5 (.spv).

details: levels.rpf: 123,507 models | packs.rpf: 19,500 | core_restofworld.rpf: 870 | shared_minigame000.rpf: 777.

Strict v1.2.1 RAGE 9 classifier separates exact cr[mbfraci]_ creatures (2,617 animals), ped-rigged/gmt_ clothing, vehicle tuning/body mods (_skirt/_histr_/_bumper), exact aircraft/boat stems, and map sectors + Hide LODs/Bounds toggle.

breakthroughs.title: ETPF Descriptor Exact DXGI_FORMAT Enum Discovery (357,115 / 357,115)
breakthroughs.summary: Proved ETPF descriptor u1 bits 3..9 ((u1 >> 3) & 0x7F) directly store the standard Microsoft DXGI_FORMAT enum across all 357,115 textures in all 57 .ttpf archives — eliminating every unknown format.
details: Unlocked 3,373 textures in textures.rpf (including +1,604 previously failing HDR BC6H & RGBA16F surfaces) with 0 failures.
Pure-Rust decoding via texture2ddecoder + IEEE-754 float16 Reinhard tonemapping + safe BC6H mode-15 sanitizer built directly into PercyStar.

breakthroughs.title: Xbox Series X (Scarlett / RDNA2) 4KB & 64KB Deswizzle Equations
breakthroughs.summary: Exhaustively solved and visually verified exact AMD GFX10/RDNA2 SW_4KB_D and 64KB TTPF tile Morton bit permutations for all 5 element sizes (8bpp, 16bpp, 32bpp, 64bpp, 128bpp) plus reverse-mip mip0 tail layout.
details: 32bpp (4B): x0,x1,y0,y1,x2,y2,y3,x3,y4,x4,(y5,x5,y6,x6) — verified on 1024x1024 RGBA8 surfaces
16bpp (2B): x0,x1,x2,y0,y1,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4,x5,(y5,x6,y6,x7) — verified on R16_FLOAT surfaces
8bpp (1B): y0,y1,y2,x1,x0,x2,y3,x3,x4,y4,x5,y5,(x6,y6,x7,y7) — verified on 1024x1024 R8 VFX sheets
Multi-mip surfaces store mipmaps smallest-to-largest; mip0 sits at alloc_end - padded_mip0_size.

breakthroughs.title: RDS5 Virtual Offset & Hardware BCPack Codec Bitfield
breakthroughs.summary: Decoded every bit of the 8-byte RDS5 chunk table entry (lo, hi): exact 4KB-aligned virtual stream offsets without sequential inflation plus exact per-chunk codec flags.
details: Compressed end: (lo & 0x03FFFFFF) * 0x100; Virtual end: (hi & 0x000FFFFF) * 0x4000 + (lo >> 30) * 0x1000.
Codec field (lo >> 26) & 0xF describes the next chunk: 0=RAW, 1..7=Xbox Hardware BCPack (BC1..BC7), 8=ZLIB.
Across all 57 .ttpf databases (1,026,890 chunks / 151.57 GB virtual): 89.42% (134.77 GB) is plain ZLIB; 10.57% uses Xbox Series X ASIC BCPack.

breakthroughs.title: RAGE 9 0DRPz Multi-Chunk Localization & String Database
breakthroughs.summary: Identified RAGE 9's 0DRPz resource layout (virtual header + 0x60 UTF-8 string pool + multi-chunk virtual continuation) across 13,459 tables totaling 3.63 million strings in 11 languages.
details: 215,654 unique English strings parsed across UI menus, settings, vehicles, weapons, wardrobe, radio metadata, and mission text.
PercyStar natively decodes both 0DRPz resources and standalone string pools under UI & Text with searchable preview-slug filenames.

breakthroughs.title: Hybrid UI Architecture: RBF0 (fwui) + Scaleform GFx v42 (AS3)
breakthroughs.summary: Resolved the 4-byte GTA VI RBF0 header marker (0xFB 0xFF 0x01 0x00) to decode 1,263/1,263 binary fwui resources into clean XML, alongside 87 Scaleform GFx v42 ActionScript 3 binaries.
details: Confirmed hybrid UI stack: modern RAGE fwui/UIObject (RBF0) + Scaleform GFx v42 (0x2A).
Both RBF0 -> XML rendering/export and GFx v42 AS3 symbol/package inspection are native inside PercyStar.

breakthroughs.title: Full CNavMesh (0x00010015) World Reconstruction & 3D Tile Viewer
breakthroughs.summary: Decoded all 27,482 CNavMesh tiles (124,742,966 polygons), 9,595 path regions, and 27,482 heightgrids to map the entire 17.41 km x 23.04 km world (115.19 km² land, 285.95 km² water, Z -79m..+404m).
details: Exact tile grid mapping: idx = gy * 512 + gx (128m x 128m tiles), 44-byte TNavMeshPoly flags for land/water/road/pavement/interior.
Published full interactive Leaflet map + 4353x5761 composite/height/density/flag layers at mapnavmeshsite.vercel.app.
PercyStar renders any CNavMesh tile natively in 3D shaded by surface type and exports clean .OBJ geometry.
